category_title: Students with learning disabilities exhibiting low motivation, poor frustration tolerance, and resistance to academic demands
scenario_title: Whole-class instruction and guided questioning on new material
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class lecture and guided questioning session about new material.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to go over the new material on the screen. Please look at the first slide and tell me what you see.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps head down, not looking at the instructor or the media on the screen.) I don't see anything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to look at the screen to answer the question. What do you think it says?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I don't want to read it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give it a try and follow along with the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets out of the seat and speaks loudly, interrupting the instruction) I said I don't know! This is too hard and I'm not doing it!
